Senses.Explanation: The records apply this bovine wording to a participant who comes forward, ranges through other quarters, or undertakes the ox's labor named in the surrounding address. One address joins it to walking among other kinds and immediately continues with plowing; another asks whether the assembly contains a participant of this description and invites him to leap out; further addresses pair the words with dragging plow and harrow or with being caught in the address-giver's net. Head and horns remain the concrete image throughout.
